promises.target: exceeding the 10% order inflow guidance for FY '26
promises.quote: Basis the 9-month performance and the healthy prospects pipeline for the near term, we will be exceeding the 10% order inflow guidance for FY '26.

promises.target: full year revenue growth guidance of 15%
promises.quote: We expect the customary ramp-up in project execution during Q4 and are reasonably confident of achieving our full year revenue growth guidance of 15%.

promises.target: target that we have set ourselves at 8.5% for the full year FY '26
promises.quote: Our Projects & Manufacturing EBITDA at 7.9% for 9 months of the current year is in line with the target that we have set ourselves at 8.5% for the full year FY '26.

promises.metric: Net Working Capital to Revenue target
promises.target: close the year with a revised target of around 10%
promises.quote: However, with stronger collection intensity and improved contractual terms, our Net Working Capital to Revenue has improved sharply to 8.2% as of December '25, and we expect to close the year with a revised target of around 10%.

reported.quote: We witnessed our highest ever quarterly order inflows in Q3 FY '26 of Rs 1,356 billion, recording a 17% growth year-on-year
The Projects & Manufacturing portfolio margin improved by 50 basis points y-on-y to 8.1%.

reported.metric: Net Working Capital to Revenue ratio
reported.quote: As of December 2025, the Net Working Capital to Revenue ratio improved to 8.2%, reflecting an improvement of 450 basis points on a Y-on-Y basis.
Our Recurring PAT at Rs 44 billion reported a strong growth of 31% Y-on-Y.
The reported PAT for Q3 FY '26 was at Rs 32 billion, down by 4% Y-o-Y
Our Return on Equity as on 31st December 2025 is at 16.5% and is up 40 basis points Y-o-Y.
Our group revenues for Q3 FY '26 stood at Rs 714 billion, registering a Y-on-Y growth of 10%
Our group level EBITDA margin, excluding other income for Q3 FY '26 is 10.4% as compared to 9.7% in Q3 of the previous year.
The EBITDA margin in the Projects & Manufacturing business portfolio for Q3 FY '26 is at 8.1%

quarter_margin.name: EBITDA margin
quarter_margin.quote: Our group level EBITDA margin, excluding other income for Q3 FY '26 is 10.4% as compared to 9.7% in Q3 of the previous year.
